title: "Examples"

## `F` and `_` (singleton)
```{python}
from placeholder import _

_.real
```

```{python}
nums = (0 + 2j), (1 + 1j), (2 + 0j)
min(nums, key=_.real)
```

```{python}
min(nums, key=_.imag)
```

```{python}
_[0]
```

```{python}
pairs = "ac", "bb", "ca"
min(pairs, key=_[0])
```

```{python}
min(pairs, key=_[-1])
```

```{python}
import itertools

list(itertools.accumulate(range(1, 6), _ * _))
```

```{python}
list(itertools.filterfalse(_ % 2, range(10)))
```

```{python}
list(filter(_ % 2 == 0, range(10)))
```

```{python}
list(filter(abs(_) < 1, [-1, 0, 1]))
```

## `M` and `m` (singleton)
Support for `attrgetter(*)`, `itemgetter(*)`, and `methodcaller`.

```{python}
from placeholder import m

m("real", "imag")
```

```{python}
m[0, -1]
```

```{python}
m.split("-")
```
